queries.text: Why does renaming or removing a certification test break gov contract verify? What is the governed evidence map for?
Which Contract v3 capability and which frozen Phase-2 acceptance criterion require every capability to have a running evidence owner?
Where in code does gov contract verify resolve evidence owners against the product and fail on a capability with no running owner?
Which tests prove that the contract-binding chain and the evidence map are verified and that a missing owner fails?
What depends on the evidence map and what becomes stale if the evidence map or the contract source changes?
